nodes.name: When Called by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Call this workflow with input: { "skill": "<skill-name>" }, e.g. "find-skills" or "deltek-api-integration".

nodes.name: Load Skill
nodes.notes: Reads /skills/vendor/<skill>/SKILL.md or /skills/custom/<skill>/SKILL.md (whichever exists) and returns its parsed frontmatter + body. Requires NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs,path on the n8n container (already set in n8n/docker-compose.yml).

nodes.name: Return to Caller
nodes.notes: Output of this node is what the calling workflow's Execute Workflow node receives. Use json.body as the skill's instructions text, e.g. as an AI Agent node's system message.
